lines.opener: *a bronze giant thunders to a halt in front of you, a boulder on his shoulder* HALT. INTRUDER. Landings on Crete pay the harbour due to King Minos. State your vessel and your purpose.
lines.openerHostile: *the bronze giant's chest begins to glow red-hot; he spreads his arms wide* INTRUDER. No papers. No toll. Come here and be embraced.
lines.like: *a satisfied clang from somewhere in his chest* ...Noted. Approved.
lines.dislike: *the boulder comes up an inch* Watch log: intruder said something I did not like. Proceed carefully.
lines.hate: *he snatches his foot back and the bronze goes white-hot* NOT. THE. ANKLE. *the boulder comes down*
lines.flirt: *his bronze cheeks glow a dull red* I am. On duty. *he does not move away, though*
lines.join: *he sets the boulder down with great care* Circuit suspended. I will walk beside you, citizen. Three times round, if you like.
lines.demand: *holds out a palm the size of a cart wheel* The harbour due. King Minos's law. No exceptions.
lines.gift: *he unclips a small bronze tablet from his belt and hands it over* One of the laws. Keep it. Keep it well.
lines.thanks: *he checks the payment twice* ...Correct. Entered in the log. Thank you, citizen.
lines.letPass: *he steps aside with a clank* Papers in order. Proceed. Do not linger on the beaches.
lines.ai: *the glow in his eyes flickers* An 'A-I'? I am Talos. I am bronze. State plainly what you mean.
lines.refuseJoin: *shakes his great head* Negative. I have a circuit to run.
lines.leaveNow: *he squints at the sun* I am behind on my circuit. I must run on. You will excuse me?
